content.short: Cipher Trace is a crypto-security organization that enforces compliance and investigates fraud.
content.description: Cipher Trace strengthens security by enforcing compliance standards and continuously monitoring and investigating fraud-related incidents across blockchain activity. It offers training programs to help organizations elevate their security posture and readiness. For developers, its tooling enables tracing of on-chain transactions and analysis of smart contract activity, supporting risk identification and mitigation. Since its inception in 2015, Cipher Trace has served teams seeking rigorous oversight of crypto operations.
